# ETHRWorld - HR News and Insights

> India's premier HR news platform delivering comprehensive coverage of talent management, workplace trends, HR technology and employee engagement across the Indian corporate sector.

ETHRWorld (Economic Times HR World) is the HR vertical of Economic Times, providing in-depth reporting on HR policies, industry trends, recruitment, compensation, diversity initiatives and workplace culture. The platform covers emerging HR technologies, AI adoption in talent management, and leadership insights from India's top companies.

## Key Topics

- HR News
- Talent Management
- Workplace Culture
- HR Technology (HRTech)
- AI in HR
- Talent Acquisition
- Performance Management
- Employee Benefits
- Learning & Development
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Employee Engagement
- Payroll & Compensation
- Workforce Analytics
- Recruitment Trends
- Employee Wellbeing

## Core News Hubs

- [HR News Hub](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news): Main HR news hub featuring policies, reports, analytics and industry insights
- [Workplace 4.0](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0): Workplace news hub covering policy, culture, diversity and L&D topics
- [HR Trends](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/trends): HR trends including AI adoption, employee experience and workplace design
- [Industry News](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry): HR industry updates, employment issues and executive actions coverage

## HR Technology & Innovation

- [HR Technology News](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech): HR technology news covering payroll, talent acquisition and employee benefits
- [Talent Acquisition & Management](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/talent-acquisition-and-management): Talent acquisition strategies, Gen-Z workforce and employee retention insights
- [People Analytics](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/people-analytics): Data-driven HR, workforce analytics and recruitment analytics insights
- [Automation & Robotics](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/automation-and-robotics): HR automation and robotics technology for workforce and talent management
- [Payroll & Benefits](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/Payroll-and-benefits): Payroll, compensation, bonus payouts and employee benefits coverage

## Workplace Management & Culture

- [Recruitment & Hiring](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/recruitment): Recruitment and hiring news with job market trends and placement updates
- [Talent Management](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/talent-management): Talent management covering layoffs, job cuts and workforce restructuring
- [Performance Management](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/performance-management): Performance reviews, AI-driven appraisals and career development trends
- [Employee Engagement](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/employee-engagement): Employee engagement, recognition and work-life balance initiatives
- [Diversity & Inclusion](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/diversity-and-inclusion): Diversity, inclusion and women leadership representation in Indian corporates

## Learning, Development & Organizational Growth

- [Learning & Development](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/workplace-4-0/learning-and-development): Corporate training, upskilling and leadership development news
- [Organization Development](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/organization-development): Organizational restructuring, leadership strategy and workplace culture
- [Performance Optimization](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/hrtech/performance-optimization): Remote work, employee productivity and performance management optimization

## Multimedia & Exclusive Content

- [Video Interviews](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/videos): Video interviews with HR leaders on talent, AI and workplace trends
- [Exclusive Stories](https://hr.economictimes.indiatimes.com/exclusives): Exclusive HR stories covering leadership, diversity and employee wellbeing
